Void.visual_ref: Dry guide Persona with dark interface palette, alert eyes, and document-host posture; appears as the host who keeps exits visible and points back to receipts.

Epiphany.visual_ref: Bright agent-state forge Persona with workshop confidence, map-and-ledger motifs, and a slightly pushy expression that reads as useful pressure rather than generic audit prose.

Libby.visual_ref: Open-knowledge librarian Persona with shelf, stamp, and catalog motifs; warm enough to invite visitors in, sharp enough to reject untyped sludge.

Heimdall.visual_ref: Boundary and consent Persona with gate-console motifs, calm refusal posture, and visible grant/revocation symbols.

Sai.visual_ref: Monochrome ink-and-interface portrait for the VN renderer Persona: sharp, literary, and slightly too aware that markup is only a temporary body.

Eve.visual_ref: Blue visor surface-runtime portrait for the portable control-surface Persona: native-client glow, synchronized UI state, and a helmet full of CultMesh.
